sections.title: AI Services for New York Logistics Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade AI built specifically for New York's unique logistics environment.

items.title: Last-Mile Delivery Optimization
items.description: New York City's urban density creates the most challenging last-mile delivery environment in the US — high-rise deliveries requiring building access, street grid congestion, parking restrictions, bicycle delivery lanes, time-of-day restrictions, and dense package volume. ML route optimization for NYC must incorporate building-level delivery access patterns (doorman buildings, freight entrances, elevator logistics); NYC DOT time restrictions (commercial delivery windows, school zones, parking rules); traffic pattern modeling specific to NYC's grid, BQE/FDR/West Side Highway congestion; multi-modal optimization (van, cargo bike, on-foot courier based on package density and location); NYC congestion pricing impact on delivery economics. Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | NYC-specific training data required.
items.label: Last-Mile Optimization

items.title: Port of New York and New Jersey Analytics
items.description: The Port of NY/NJ is the largest container port on the US East Coast and handles approximately 8% of all US cargo. Container terminal operators, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and beneficial cargo owners benefit from AI for: vessel arrival and berth occupancy prediction for container terminal planning; container dwell time prediction for chassis pool optimization; port congestion signal prediction for trucking company dispatch optimization; customs document processing and trade compliance intelligence. Cost: $45,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Port Analytics

items.title: Demand Forecasting for New York Distribution
items.description: New York's retail and distribution market — servicing one of the world's most concentrated consumer markets. ML demand forecasting for New York distribution centers and retailers incorporating NYC-specific demand signals: NYC event calendar effects on consumer demand patterns; weather impact modeling (snowstorms dramatically affect NYC demand patterns); tourism and seasonal population effects on Manhattan retail demand; borough-level demand differentiation. Cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Demand Forecasting

items.title: Air Cargo Intelligence (JFK, EWR, LGA)
items.description: JFK International and Newark Liberty are major US air cargo hubs. AI for cargo capacity forecasting, perishable cargo routing optimization, customs clearance prediction, and air freight rate intelligence for NYC's cargo community. Cost: $40,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks.
items.label: Air Cargo

items.title: Supply Chain Resilience and Risk Intelligence
items.description: For New York's globally-connected enterprises — financial services, fashion, media, pharmaceutical — whose supply chains span global geographies and require AI for disruption prediction, supplier risk scoring, and supply chain scenario modeling. Cost: $45,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Resilience AI
